_source: Words the German must not contain. AGENTS.md §3: the site says Produkt and Produktkategorie and never catalogue, article or basket/cart (Katalog, Warenkorb, Einkaufswagen); German is written in the Sie form (locale de_DE_formal), so the du/ihr forms are banned. 'Artikel' is not listed: German legal texts cite 'Artikel 6 DSGVO'. A word matches as a whole word, ignoring case; a word ending in * also matches its compounds and inflections.
